items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: he had a band out in the Cotton Club... he used to let me come out and sit in with his band. And then later he came to New York and I played in Nick's with his band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was out of the band before I came in, but I heard the records. I have the records here, and it's lovely.
Yeah, I have that record. And I have a great record of Calloway's called 'Willow Weep for me.' And I always thought that was Eddie Barefield and somebody --
